name: Brandon Moreno
profileSummary: Brandon Moreno Carrillo is a Mexican professional mixed martial artist. He currently competes in the Flyweight division of the Ultimate Fighting Championship (UFC), where he is a former two-time UFC Flyweight Champion and the first Mexican fighter to win a UFC championship. A professional since 2011, Moreno also competed for the Legacy Fighting Alliance, where he was the Legacy Fighting Alliance Flyweight Champion. As of July 25, 2026, he is #10 in the Meta UFC flyweight rankings.
